name: dTRINITY Staked dUSD
oneLiner: sdUSD is dTRINITY's yield-bearing dUSD vault receipt; staked dUSD is supplied into dLEND and the share price accrues lending yield.
collateral: dUSD deposited into dTRINITY dSTAKE vaults and supplied into dLEND; deployments are chain-isolated and non-fungible across networks.
pegMechanism: Stake dUSD to mint sdUSD vault receipts and unstake back into dUSD when dLEND liquidity is available; dSTAKE charges no staking fee, unstaking can incur up to 10 bps retained by the vault, and NAV appreciates as dLEND supply APY accrues.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30. Official documentation lists only the Ethereum and Fraxtal sdUSD vault receipts and states that deployments are chain-isolated. Pinned source re-read (dtrinity/ethereum-solidity-contracts commit d3103f88): DStakeTokenV2 does not override share transfers and is not Pausable; burnFromRouter skips allowance only when initiator equals owner, and the live DStakeRouterV2 passes msg.sender as initiator, so the current router cannot seize third-party shares; router PAUSER_ROLE pauses deposits and redemptions, not share transfers; the only seizure-capable path is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE calling migrateCore() behind the 86400-second timelock (3-of-5 Safe) to install a candidate router. At Ethereum block 25656501 the proxy EIP-1967 implementation slot still resolved to DStakeTokenV2 0x9c278036c3c4529472751502dfc71bb1f0a3bfd4 and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b) returned true; at Fraxtal block 39317837 the proxy still resolved to DStakeToken 0x0f51b15939a42bd995ecd3a2c151dc58621856c6. Neither deployment has a live blacklist, pause, or transfer hook, so the wrapper carries no independent live freeze verdict. The governing live exposure is upstream: dUSD (dusd-dtrinity, recorded in mintAuthority.inheritedFrom) was re-reviewed 2026-07-30 with a true verdict - a live PAUSER_ROLE can halt all dUSD transfers globally, which would block sdUSD mint and redemption flows while sdUSD share transfers themselves stay unpaused. The verdict is therefore inherited from that named upstream; the wrapper's timelock-mutable seizure path above remains documented but requires a 24-hour governance action, not a live call. The Terms describe interface/protocol restrictions and upgrades in general terms but do not establish a current token-holder blacklist.

notices.title: Liquidity-gated unstaking
notices.message: sdUSD unstaking depends on available dUSD liquidity in dLEND; when utilization is high, holders may need to wait for borrowers to repay or sell sdUSD on secondary markets.

mintAuthority.summary: sdUSD (dSTAKE vault) is upgradeable via ProxyAdmin owned by a 24-hour TimelockController, whose proposer/executor/canceller is a single 3-of-5 Safe multisig (0xe83c188...). Shares are minted only by staking dUSD — no privileged mint surface. Fraxtal's DStakeProxyAdmin is owned by a separate 24-hour TimelockController (0x0bafaDA2...) whose proposer/executor/canceller role is a 3-of-5 Safe (0xFC2f89f9...) holding the identical five-owner set as the Ethereum Safe.

controls.label: Inherited dUSD AMO/governed-reserve mint authority
controls.evidence: Resolved 2026-07-30 against the parent dusd-dtrinity authority graph. Underlying dUSD is minted by documented MINTER_ROLE contracts (Ethereum AMO Manager 0x29532F74A9302e0a1E9f7d015FE355FFdE6e6880, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) re-verified true at Ethereum block 25656501, plus the flagged undocumented second minter 0xf84cc8217713a53fc3e3eb2d62d2af33a084ff85) against a governance-set whitelist of reserve stablecoins, with AMO pre-minting into Curve pools. The dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the 86400-second TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b (hasRole re-verified true at block 25656501) resolving to the same 3-of-5 governance Safe 0xE83c188a7BE46B90715C757A06cF917175f30262 as this wrapper; Fraxtal and Katana follow the same timelocked 3-of-5 pattern, while Sonic's admin sits directly under a 2-of-4 Safe with no timelock. The dUSD token exposes no supply cap, so the inherited authority can raise effective sdUSD backing supply without a cap; sdUSD share mint itself remains deposit-backed. sdUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture, plus the March 17 2026 dTRINITY exploit exposure noted on the dUSD profile.

controls.label: dSTAKE Fraxtal upgrade Safe (via 24-hour TimelockController)
controls.evidence: At Fraxtal block 38906249, owner() on DStakeProxyAdmin 0xde914ec384346fea47339e5086d2d399b7f4733b returned 0x0bafaDA2a5824864720873EE40cd960b36445212, an OpenZeppelin TimelockController (getMinDelay()=86400 seconds), not an EOA. That timelock's only RoleGranted events (from deployment, no RoleRevoked events found) show PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE all granted to Safe 0xFC2f89f9982Be98A9672CEfc3eA6dbBDd88Bc8e9. The Safe (v1.3.0) returned the five owners recorded here, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard — an identical owner set and threshold to the Ethereum-side Safe, deployed as a separate per-chain instance.
